public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.nextLine();
        int i = 0, j = 1;
        int n = str.length();
        int count = 1, res = 0;

        for (;;) {
            if (j < n && str.charAt(i) == str.charAt(j)) {
                count++;
                j++;
            } else {
                if (count % 2 == 0)

                i = j;
                j++;
            }
        }

}

    static void recurse(String s, int i, int j, int count, int[] res, int n) {
        if (j < n && s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) {
            recurse(s, i, j + 1, count + 1, res, n);
        } else {
            if (count % 2 == 0)

        }
    }
